RIGHT panel (obtuse angles) holds 6 angles: (1) at the top, vertex at the middle with a slanting arm going up-left and a horizontal arm going right, about 150 degrees; (2) vertex at the top of a small angle with arms going left-down (shallow) and right-down, about 120 degrees; (3) at the left, vertex on the left with arms going up-right and down-right, about 120 degrees; (4) a flat 'v' in the middle, vertex at the bottom with a nearly horizontal arm going left and a rising arm going right, about 150 degrees; (5) a corner at the right, a vertical arm going up and a nearly horizontal arm going left from the vertex, a little more than a right angle (about 100 degrees); (6) a flat 'v' at the bottom, vertex at the bottom with two long arms rising left and right, about 144 degrees. description: Eight origami steps drawn as flat light-blue/lavender shapes with a darker blue outline, laid out in two rows of four, each step with a dark blue filled numbered circle above it (1 to 8); dashed lines show where to fold and thin curved arrows show the direction of the fold. Row 1: Step 1: a square with a dashed diagonal from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner and a curved arrow across the diagonal (fold the lower-left triangle up over the diagonal). Step 2: a large triangle with the apex at the top and its base at the bottom (the square folded in half along the diagonal); a horizontal dashed line near the bottom (a quarter of the height above the base), and a small curved arrow below the base on the left pointing up (fold the bottom strip up). Step 3: a boat shape: a wide trapezoid (wider at the top) at the bottom with a triangle sitting on top; a vertical dashed line from the apex of the triangle down through the middle of the trapezoid, a short slanted dashed line at the lower left of the triangle, and a small curved arrow near the centre (fold the corners). Step 4: the paper partly folded: a solid vertical edge in the middle, a small triangular flap pointing up on the left, a wide trapezoid at the bottom right, dashed slanted lines near the bottom and a small curved arrow near the middle right (another fold). Row 2: Step 5: a diamond (square standing on a corner) with a thin vertical central slit/crease and two upward ears (small triangles) at the top left and top right, and a small curly (looping) arrow to the left of the shape (turn the paper over). Step 6: a diamond with two upward ears at the top and a small triangle between them, a horizontal dashed line across the diamond near the top (through the base of the ears) and a curved arrow pointing left near the top (fold the top triangle down). Step 7: a pentagon-like shape (a diamond whose top is flat) with two separate upright ear flaps on the top and a gap between them; a short horizontal dashed line near the bottom point and a small curved arrow below the bottom point (fold the bottom tip up/behind). Step 8: the finished rabbit face: a hexagon-like face (flat top and bottom, pointed sides) with two tall ears rising from the top separated by a gap, two dark blue oval eyes, a dark blue small triangular nose and a little curved mouth below it. No degree numbers or letters appear in the pictures.
unclear: Shapes of steps 3 to 7 are small stylised origami drawings; their exact fold geometry (which edge is folded onto which) and the direction of some small arrows could not be read with certainty. No angle is marked on any step.
